verdict.rationale: Linear's official 'Rate limiting' docs publish exact limits per authentication type: 2,500 requests/hour per user for API keys, 5,000 for OAuth apps, and 600 per IP when unauthenticated. They also document leaky-bucket refill, query complexity limits, and X-RateLimit response headers, so a builder can plan automation at scale before starting. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of concurrency caps (simultaneous request limits), independent or hands-on corroboration of the published limits.
